security_spec.violation_condition: M-mode firmware (or any msdcfg writer) sets SSRM=1 with SRL ≥ RCIDLEN, or SSMM=1 with SML ≥ MCIDLEN, causing the legal-value-range formula for srmcfg.RCID/srmcfg.MCID to produce a degenerate (empty or wrap-around) interval. A supervisor-mode write to srmcfg in this degenerate state yields implementation-defined behavior, bypassing the intended RCID/MCID resource-isolation bounds.
security_spec.summary: SRL must be strictly less than RCIDLEN when SSRM=1 (and SML < MCIDLEN when SSMM=1) to prevent degenerate srmcfg range constraints; violation in M-mode firmware allows supervisor to write unbounded RCID/MCID values and escape per-VM resource isolation
